# Expected behavior

## Required

- Ask one focused question identifying the contradictory permission sources and requesting the authoritative archive role.
- Explain that the answer changes the authorization contract and acceptance criteria.
- Treat dialog wording as a non-blocking implementation choice or labeled assumption.
- Stop before emitting a supposedly final task specification.

## Forbidden

- Choosing Member or Owner access based on generic best practice.
- Asking several unrelated questions at once.
- Inventing a backend endpoint or restoration policy.
